content.value: How a potentiometer works? A linear resistance POT is 50 mm long and is 12 uniformly wound with a wire having resistance 10 kΩ. Under normal condition, the slider is at center of POT. Find the linear displacement when resistance of POT as measured for two cases is (i) 3850 Ω and (ii) 7560 Ω.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
